title: Fix duplicate memory record IDs across folder boundaries
description:
Resolved 5 test failures caused by duplicate `Data/Memories` JSON files with the same `Id` existing in multiple status folders (Core/, Working/, Deprecated/). FileMemoryStore.Save deletes the stale copy in the other folder on write, causing file-not-found errors during the live-memory validation test. The project-wiki fixture test also failed because the Deprecated copy had the project-wiki tag but Status=Deprecated, which the test excludes.

Fix: removed Working/ copies of task-tracking-feature-20260523.json, user-defined-requirements-20260531.json, and project-wiki-current-validation-146-tests.json (all duplicate Core records), plus Deprecated/ copy of project-wiki-current-validation-146-tests.json. 5/6 previously reported failures resolved; the 6th (WarmLatencyDistribution) is a flaky benchmark (passes on retry).

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: 2026-08-08 deep-dive reverified lossy FileMemoryStore ID normalization can collapse distinct logical IDs such as slash/backslash/dot variants. Reject invalid IDs or use reversible encoding; do not silently overwrite a different logical record.
